posts.title: New Product: Expunge It Eraser
posts.description: New product! The Expunge It Eraser. It’s a little rubber eraser that resembles a dish sponge in a minimalist form: the top is green and the base is yellow. I’ve wanted to make it years ago but kept putting it off for various reasons, but now that it’s here, I think it’s adorable.

posts.title: Toronto Stationery Show 2026
